summary: Your claim for acupuncture on 5/28/2026 was denied because acupuncture is not a covered benefit under your Sunrise Health PPO plan. The service cost $240. You are responsible for this full amount. However, you have the right to appeal this decision.

lines.explanation: Acupuncture (CPT 97810) is not covered by your plan. PR-204 states: "this service is not a covered benefit under your plan, so the full allowed amount is your responsibility." [CODE-PR-204] The remark code N130 suggests you "review your plan's benefit documents for the rules that apply to this service." [CODE-N130] You owe the full $240 billed amount.

citations.quote: PR-204 means this service is not a covered benefit under your plan, so the full allowed amount is your responsibility.
Remark code N130 directs you to review your plan's benefit documents for the rules that apply to this service.

actions: Contact Meridian Wellness Clinic to discuss payment arrangements or ask if they offer a self-pay discount.
Review your Sunrise Health PPO plan documents to confirm acupuncture coverage rules.

If you believe acupuncture should be covered (for example, due to a medical condition or prior authorization), file an appeal. According to CODE-PR-204, "You have the right to appeal if you believe the service should be covered, starting with an internal appeal."
Keep this EOB and any documentation of your appeal for your records.
